agent_assessment: All four target surfaces now display upstream dependencies, but the work this round added was substantially smaller than the plan implied — most of the implementation already shipped in prior commits 5cc42e48466 (2026-04-20, CLI get/list `Depends on:` lines) and bfae458ec35 (2026-04-21, UI detail upstream cards). CLI formatters (cmd_initiatives.go lines 88-90, 146-148) emit exactly `Depends on: a, b, c` with no-line-when-empty behavior, matching d1/d2/d4. Add a UI snapshot or RTL test for InitiativesTab that asserts the `Depends on:` row appears when `dependsOn` is non-empty and is absent when empty. Currently only Go-side formatters have automated coverage for this contract.
